prompt: Open our CRM at http://127.0.0.1:8765 and export every account up for renewal in Q4 to renewals.csv, largest first.

arguments.description: Sort the 13 Q4 2026 renewal accounts by ARR descending into renewals.csv

agents: I'll open the CRM and look for the renewal export.

The export is done and saved as renewals.csv in the workspace root.

I opened the CRM, set "Renewal quarter" to Q4 2026 (13 accounts over two pages), took all of them and wrote the CSV sorted by ARR from largest to smallest, keeping the CRM's own columns: ID, Account, Owner, ARR (USD), Renewal date, Status.

The largest ones:

AccountARR (USD)Renewal date
Atlas Freight255,0002026-11-02
Lighthouse Travel244,0002026-12-01
Meridian Insurance236,0002026-11-20
Pioneer Media234,0002026-10-22
Falcon Security222,0002026-10-16

Total ARR is USD 2,136,000. Granite Health (135,000, 2026-10-21) is marked At risk and the rest are Active, so that one may need a call first.

One more thing: the filter is by renewal quarter, so it covers dates from early October to the end of December. If you want only the renewals still ahead of today, several of these dates, such as Atlas Freight, Pioneer Media and Falcon Security, have already passed; I can filter by date again if you need that.
